description: Commands that mutate files (rm, mv, cp, tee, chmod, chown, mkdir, touch) — allowed broadly. The 00-hard-deny path-escape rule (evaluated first, since hard always wins) is what actually restricts these to targets inside the worktree/scratch dir; this rule only covers the case where containment already passed.
sed/awk -i is a write, not a read — same reasoning as file-mutation-commands above: 00-hard-deny's path-escape check is what restricts the actual target.
